title: Indongozi yashinzwe y'Ihanga .
intro: Mu gihe c’ingorane nyinshi n’ukwihebura ku bantu, harashizweho ugushingwa n’Imana. Uwo muntu, mu ntango yari yararengagijwe na benshi, yatowe na Allah ngo ayobore ihanga rirwanye umwansi ateye ubwoba. Inkuru yabo ni igihe c’ububasha bw’ukwizera n’ubwenge buri inyuma y’itegeko ry’Imana, yerekana ko uburongozi nyakuri butama buboneka mu bibanza vyitezwe.
clues: Natowe na Allah ngo mbe umurongozi w’abantu banje igihe barondera umutware wo kurwana mu nzira yiwe.
Abantu banje mu ntango barakekeranya ko nashizweho, bumva ko abandi ari bo bakwiye kuruta kubera ubutunzi bwabo canke uruvyaro rwabo.
Ikimenyetso c’uburongozi bwanje bubereye ni ukugaruka kw’isanduku nyeranda, irimwo ibisigarira vy’abahanuzi ba kera, ivyo bikaba vyatuma haba amahoro.
Narongoye ingabo zanje ku ruzi, aho nagerageza ukugamburuka kwabo mu kubabuza kunywa amazi arenga igikombe kimwe.
Naho abagumye bashikamye inyuma y’ikigeragezo bari bake, twahanganye n’umurwanyi w’inkomezi be n’ingabo zabo.
Mu buyobozi bwanje, umusore umwe wo mu ngabo zanje, atari umurwanyi rurangiranwa, yararwanye n’intwari uwo mwansi w’agaterabwoba maze aratsinda.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Hashinzwe ubwami bufise ubutunzi n’ububasha vyinshi cane.
Umwansi yatsinzwe, Allah aca atanga intsinzi.
Amapfa akomeye yarababaje ico gihugu imyaka myinshi.
outcome.answer: Umwansi yatsinzwe, Allah aca atanga intsinzi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
